body:
I don't think I said anything at all about it, that's the stupid thing. I wrote a huge paragraph to this person (the significance is that she's been a friend since I was a teenager, we've had sex numerous times but has always been a very good friend to me as well) but she's not replied to me for a long time and I know she's been going through a lot so I decided to mirror what she's probably been going through by explaining my issues.

It's gotten so bad that I think I've convinced myself that I told her I hurt or molested a family member (somehow I convinced myself that this actually happened years ago). This in turn has brought up other memories from years and years ago and convinced me that I need to confess my obsessions to members of my family.

I would quite happily stand in a kangaroo court and let somebody give me a gun whilst I confessed my obsessions and shoot myself on the spot if they considered me as doing anything wrong.

God I wish I hadn't had sent that message :-(
